symptom: UPS output voltage THD exceeded 3 % at high load step with non-linear IT load
root_cause: Output filter capacitor bank degraded; inverter firmware below v4.2 lacks THD compensation
resolution: Replace output filter capacitors and upgrade inverter firmware to v4.2; retest THD at 25/50/100 % load

symptom: UPS transfer time 9 ms on mains failure, exceeds 4 ms
root_cause: Static bypass SCR gate driver fault
resolution: Replace static switch gate driver board; verify transfer with power quality analyser

symptom: Generator failed to accept load within 10 s during IST
root_cause: Low jacket-water heater temperature delaying governor ramp
resolution: Repair jacket-water heater thermostat; set pre-heat alarm in BMS

symptom: UPS output voltage THD high above 3 % at full load
